anomaly: im-connect 层出现 channel error: 客户端连接被拒绝/断开(TooLongFrameException)

ground_truth.root_cause: 客户端发送非法协议帧(长度字段异常 1634166075 超过 LengthFieldBasedFrameDecoder 上限 8388622),Netty 解码器抛 TooLongFrameException 并断开连接,im-connect 记录 channel error
ground_truth.solution: 修复客户端协议实现(帧头长度字段正确编码);服务端可对异常帧做容错处理
ground_truth.evidence: io.netty.handler.codec.TooLongFrameException: Adjusted frame length exceeds 8388622: 1634166075; MessageHandler - channel error
